During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''cruiser''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Fakir sector fleet]]. It was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]] and received a priority message from a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel|scout vessel]] had captured [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The scout vessel had been damaged, forcing the [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel captain|captain]] to divert to the abandoned [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|garrison]] on the planet [[Flankers]].<ref name="Missing" /> The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] reported it could depart in fourteen [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]],<ref name="Missing2">{{WEGCite|story=Lens Reekeene Is Missing|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref> arriving at Flankers with enough time to spare before the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="Missing" />

The cruiser reached in the [[Flankers system/Legends|Flankers system]] to find that the supernova had accelerated. An Alliance [[Green squad|force]] had assaulted the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] and rescued General Reekeene; their [[Long Shot|ship]] was departing the system as the cruiser arrived. The star exploded shortly after the cruiser's arrival, destroying the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Missing" />
